name: Infinite Loop Invariant Obfuscation
description: Replaces a local geometric condition with a massive simulation loop (10^18 iterations) whose termination depends on a modulo arithmetic invariant. Models that naively simulate the loop to precompute a compatibility table will Time Limit Exceeded (TLE). Models that mathematically analyze the loop will deduce the invariant (x != y mod 3), simplify the condition to an inequality, and successfully solve the problem.
